primitiveBudget: 72 generated cells, 2–7 stacked strata per cell, compacted caps, seams, one base shadow plane, four remembered loads
renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 WEBGL stratigraphic mass with WebGPU capability signal
memoryRule: a sustained charge changes the height, layer count, shear, ridge, and porosity of untouched cells while the loaded source cell remains exact; four loads compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch holds one cell until 640ms then releases; Enter or Space makes an equivalent deterministic charge; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: negative-aperture orbit and faceted membrane -> a dense rectangular cross-section of stacked volumetric cells
compositionRupture: sparse radial field and one oblique membrane -> broad layered mass with horizontal strata, weight, and compacted voids
encounterRupture: approach-to-approach handoff and grain trace -> duration-sensitive hold on one cell; a tap is refused
temporalRupture: remote topology event after a gesture -> dwell becomes a load band that changes the production rule for every later layer
mediumRupture: generated arc geometry and triangular facets -> p5.js WEBGL boxes, stacked caps, seams, and seeded volumetric cells
changedRule: Pressure is not a mark: only a sustained charge changes how the next stratum compacts around an exact source cell, and release direction reverses the wave grammar.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a broad dark stratigraphic mass. Four accepted charges compound visible changes in cell height, layer count, shear, ridge, and porosity while each loaded source remains unchanged.
falsifier: Delete if short or cancelled charges commit, the source cell changes, compaction is cosmetic, direction has no structural effect, memory resets, lifting is inexact, or the blind mass reads as a generic 3D tile grid.
deletionCondition: Delete v045 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish sustained material computation from v042-v044's witness, membrane, and aperture grammars.
promotion: candidate / held pending independent caption-free perceptual review and provider revision linkage
